current.text: Kennard signed with Phoenix in free agency.
Too many guards are ahead of him in Phoenix for him to make a fantasy impact.
Booker, Jalen Green, Miles Bridges and Dillon Brooks are expected to take most of the Suns' minutes and usage, which leaves little room for bench guards.
Ben expects him to come off the bench and take about eight threes a game, making about 40 to 41% of them. That would be more volume at a lower percentage than before.
Ben worries that the Suns' projected starting lineup has no reliable three-point shooting.

durable.text: Kennard is a pure three-point shooter. He does not get to the rim and is not a mid-range shooter.
He has historically taken too few threes for a shooter of his quality.

note: He ranks 259 on Yahoo and 221 on ESPN with a value of 0 USD on both sites, so he falls well outside the 144 players drafted in our league and should not be drafted. His projected line gives efficient FG% on low volume and few turnovers (0.8 per game) but little in PTS, REB, AST, STL or BLK. Yahoo's 67.3% FT% projection does not match his 89 to 91% history, and he takes under one free throw a game anyway. Early in the season, check whether he really gets Ben's projected eight three-point attempts a game off the bench. If he does, he can be a waiver streamer for threes.
